verdict.rationale: Oneleet hosts its own Scalar-rendered API references for both the Public and Auditor APIs. They load the live OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec, and the docs explicitly call them "interactive references", so the core of the story is first-party. Whether examples actually run is only implied: the request client is the unconfigured Scalar default, and executing calls needs a real service key against your own workspace data. Missing for 10: confirmed runnable try-it requests or hands-on verification, a sandbox or test workspace for safe execution, curated example payloads, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Oneleet hosts Scalar-rendered API references for both APIs (the page loads the live OpenAPI document via data-url="./openapi.json"; the Auditor API has its own reference page).
The docs link the machine specs and consoles directly ("OpenAPI specifications and interactive references:")
Oneleet serves a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document for its Public API (157 paths) at the API origin
